newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse approves First Asia delisting.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse approves First Asia delisting.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) said on Thursday it had given conditional approval to First Asia Securities Plc to delist the firm's shares from the bourse after its merger with Securities One Plc.
The SET said in a statement that the green light was given by its board after a meeting on Wednesday.
Under the conditions of delising, Securities One must seek approval from the Secutities and Exchange Commission to make another tender offer for First Asia's shares from the public, the SET said.
Securities One launched its first tender to buy First Asia shares during July 24 to August 30, 1995.

The SET on February 10 suspended shares of First Asia Securities after the company had informed the bourse that it had agreed to sell 90 million baht ($3.46 million) of fixed assets to Securities One.
The assets sale was part of Securities One's takeover of First Asia that began last year.
